notes.title: 💔 Project Update: Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom 💔
notes.content: [p]Today, we have to share some difficult news. After much thought, we’ve made the decision to [b]end development on Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom[/b].[/p][p]This was never an easy choice. We’ve spent countless hours building its world from designing the combat with melee, magic, and shields, to shaping the Witherlings and Rotguards that lurked in the dark. We wanted to give players an atmospheric and challenging experience set deep within a kingdom lost to time.[/p][p]But sometimes, despite the passion and the work, projects don’t make it to the finish line. Between shifting priorities, limited resources, and the realities of development, continuing Labyrinth just isn’t possible.[/p][p]Though it never saw release, this project still means a great deal to us. It helped us grow as developers, try new ideas, and push ourselves further. We’re proud of what was created, even if it won’t reach its full potential.[/p][p]To everyone who supported the project or looked forward to its release [b]thank you[/b]. Your encouragement has meant the world, and it fuels us as we move forward to future projects.[/p][p]The labyrinth may remain unfinished, but its shadows will always be part of our journey.[/p][p]— [i]EvolvedPhoenix Studios[/i][/p]

notes.title: Labyrinth is Being Rebuilt from the Ground Up!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’ve got some massive news! Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom is getting a complete overhaul.

We’re rebuilding the entire game from the ground up to bring you a stronger, more polished experience. This isn’t just a patch or minor update we’re talking new systems, redesigned features, and major gameplay upgrades.

🧱 Level Editor Becomes Room Maker
One of the biggest changes: the Level Editor is being replaced with a fully-featured Room Maker.
You’ll be able to design individual room layouts with different types, sizes, and styles all of which will be used in procedural level generation. This means:

More replayability

Better layout variety

A new level of control for creators

Whether you're building puzzles, combat arenas, or story-driven chambers, this new tool gives you the power to shape the labyrinth itself.

🧪 What Else Is Changing?
While we’re not revealing everything yet, here’s a taste of what’s coming:

Core mechanics are being refined for smoother gameplay

Visual upgrades across the board

Performance boosts and network improvements

More dynamic enemy encounters

This is the beginning of a new era for Labyrinth, and we’re beyond excited to share it with you. We’ll be posting more sneak peeks soon including dev logs, concept art, and previews of the Room Maker in action.

Stay tuned, and thank you for walking this path with us.

— EvolvedPhoenix Studios 🦅🔥

notes.title: Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom Temporary Development Pause
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to reach out and update you all personally. Due to financial considerations, I've decided to temporarily pause active development and updates on Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom to focus on securing stable employment.

This decision was not easy, as the support and enthusiasm from this community have been incredible. I deeply appreciate all of you who have followed the game's journey, provided valuable feedback, and supported me along the way.

Please understand this is not a goodbye it's just a brief pause. My commitment to Labyrinth remains strong, and I look forward to returning to development with renewed energy and resources in the near future.

Thank you all for your understanding, patience, and continued support.

Warm regards,

[EvolvedPhoenix Studios]

notes.title: Unlock the Shadows: Labyrinth Reveals Its Stunning New UI!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I’ve got some exciting news to share with you all today! As of today, we’ve officially launched a BRAND NEW UI for Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom! 🎉 This new update completely overhauls the look and feel of the game, delivering a cleaner, more immersive experience with a focus on ease of use and enhanced visuals. We’ve listened to your feedback and worked hard to bring you a UI that feels fresh, intuitive, and responsive, whether you’re exploring the dark corners of the kingdom or strategizing your next move.

The new UI brings with it a host of improvements. Each element has been designed with your gameplay experience in mind, making it easier to navigate, and enjoy the world of Labyrinth: Shadows of the Kingdom.

This is just the first of many changes we have in store for the game, and we’re thrilled to continue improving it based on your feedback. As always, we’re grateful for your support and can’t wait for you to dive into the new update. Please let us know your thoughts and keep an eye out for more exciting updates coming soon!

Thank you for being part of our journey, and happy adventuring! 🙌

notes.title: Traders and Quests Update.
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 0.67-A
[/h1]
Hello everyone Today we have a pretty big Update, There are now quests in the game!!!!!

[h2]This is the person you can get quests from.
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/147b65a10fcda2ba707252e5a97e8eaa0bffed0d.png[/img]
[h2]This is the W.I.P Quest Giver UI
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/cd41a82283bc9a836d6b65d3a54ebdb4e661b5b3.png[/img]
[h2]This is the W.I.P Quest UI
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/fe3bfef24336aead708c5e92e7965f9cc21144df.png[/img]

[h2]Also we now have a full inventory system for weapons and Items
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44336444/e89ca1e05f7cc2606656859e529534db7f09db0e.png[/img]

[h2]Changes to Traders[/h2]

Traders can now be a quest. What does this mean? it means that if you get a quest called talk to [TRADER NAME] you can go talk to them and you will get the reward for that quest.

There are multiple different types of quests and those would be

[h3]AI QUESTS[/h3]
These quests are bound to specific AI's specified within the quest, Like kill 5 Skeletons will on be triggered by the Skeleton and not another AI like a spider.

[h3]TRADER TALK QUESTS[/h3]
These quests are bound to specific traders. for an example if you have a quest called talk to the Dragon, you will be able to go up to the dragon and talk to him and you will get progress towards that quest.

[h3]TALK QUESTS[/h3]
This is kind of the same thing as the TRADER TALK QUESTS but it doesn't have to be a trader for it to work, I can just be some random NPC that meets the requirements for the quest.

[h3]GATHER QUESTS[/h3]
These quests are ones bound to objects in the world like bushes, crystals, flowers and so on. upon interacting with said objects they will be collected and destroyed for the clients only. so you don't mess up someone else's progress.

[h3]REWARDS FOR QUESTS[/h3]
There are 2 different types of rewards you can get right now, and that is Credits and Weapons/Items
